These metrics suggest that AVALON is overvalued relative to its peers, carrying substantial risk for investors. Conceded: The company does show some positive financial indicators such as a ROA of 10.57% and a ROE of 15.65%, which are better than the sector average [E8] [E9]. However, these ratios do not justify the extreme valuation multiples.
